content.text: {"id": "mm6742a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Thirty cases (75%) occurred among persons at high risk for serious influenza complications."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Twenty-six (65%) patients reported direct contact with swine (i.e., touching swine or swine enclosure)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Twenty-six (65%) patients reported direct contact with swine."}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All patients reported attending one of three Maryland fairs (A [15], B [one], and C [24])"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 30 (75%) patients were at high risk for complications from influenza"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All patients reported attending one of three Maryland fairs (A [15], B [one], and C [24])"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A joint investigation with MDH and the local health department was started and later broadened"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A suspected case of variant influenza was defined as influenza-like illness (ILI) (fever and cough or sore throat)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "For phylogenetic analyses, nucleotide sequences were downloaded from GenBank for swine"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
